settings_intro: Account, API keys for server-to-server calls, variables your workflows share, and this instance.
settings_account_auth_off: Authentication is off on this instance, so there is no account to show: the API serves every call without a credential. Enable auth on the server to sign in.
settings_api_keys_description: Keys authenticate server-to-server calls. A key's secret is shown once and never again.
settings_create_key_description: Name it for where it will be used. Copy the secret now — it cannot be shown again.
settings_copy_by_hand: Select the key above and copy it by hand if the button failed.
settings_label_required: Give this key a label to continue.
settings_keys_empty_body: Create one to call the API from a backend or CI job.
settings_revoke_description: It stops authenticating immediately and permanently. The row is kept so an audit still has something to name.
settings_about_unavailable: The health endpoint did not answer.
settings_account_unavailable: Your account could not be loaded.
settings_keys_auth_off: Authentication is off, so the API accepts calls without a key. Keys you create now are enforced once authentication is enabled.
settings_keys_auth_off_empty_body: Create one now so it is ready: keys are enforced once authentication is enabled on the server.
settings_variables_description: Key/value pairs every workflow in this workspace reads as $vars.KEY. A run reads them when it starts.
settings_variables_secret_note: Values are stored as plain text and shown to anyone who can open this page. Put secrets in a credential instead.
settings_variables_delete_description: Workflows that read this variable get an empty value from their next run on.
settings_variables_empty_body: Add a base URL, an environment name or any other value your workflows share.
settings_variables_key_invalid: Use letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter or underscore (at most 64 characters).
